shader_composition_stage.name: The room can be otherwise
shader_composition_stage.description: One material on the familiar sphere, cube and sofa. Compose the repeated circle, rim and emission, then change the surrounding setting while keeping the material, bodies and lights fixed.
interactions: Grab or point-drag DOTS / RIM / GLOW
shader_composition_stage.qfep_connection: A body can keep its geometry while its material and surroundings change how it is read. The supplied library sets limits on what remains recognizable.
